note: First version: the quiet line of muted text that empty sections and hints repeat

component.doc: A quiet line of muted text, inset 4 dp to line up with a card's rounded edge: what a section says while its list is empty (wrap it in a core://Conditional on the list's count with not: true), or a hint under a heading. Secondary text by default; for a heading above a card use core:section_label.

params.name: style
params.doc: A core://Text style (Caption for a smaller hint).

examples.note: what an empty section says, inside a core://Conditional on its list's count with not: true

args.text: Last hour · last day · since the server started

examples.note: a small hint under a section's heading
